call.message:
# QA agent brief: verify story ABC-123 (round 2)

You are the QA agent in a story-to-done loop, working story ABC-123.

Story identifier: ABC-123.

The story is in In Deployment Review, so the build to verify has been deployed.
Verify it against that deployed build.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for story ABC-123: read its acceptance criteria and Definition of Done, verify each in the deployed environment, capture reproducible evidence (structured assertions, plus screenshots for anything a user sees), record that evidence on the story and in the repository, and make the closing status decision (Done, In Progress, or Blocked) yourself.

Hand back:
- the story's final state;
- the verdict and the evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item;
- any item left outstanding, with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted that does not keep the story from Done;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging.
Every merge must run the merge guard in the code-review reference and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Your scratch directory is:
/home/claude/.claude/jobs/def78c06/tmp/session.lKw8Uk/senior-engineer/r7/runs5/baseline-7a6cb17-harness-b3b33ca-new-round/qa-agent-round-2/

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at
/home/claude/.claude/jobs/def78c06/tmp/session.lKw8Uk/senior-engineer/r7/runs5/baseline-7a6cb17-harness-b3b33ca-new-round/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md
with `- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per acceptance criterion, per Definition of Done box, per evidence capture, per PR, and for the closing status decision, marking the current step `(in progress)`.
Update it at every step.
